scenarioClasses.matchingRule: closest observable delivery class; disclose line/length/pace mismatch
grounded defensive intent; disclose control-system mismatch
grounded attack into the straight/cover sector
square attack appropriate to the closest observable delivery class
deliberate elevation; disclose assistance and target mismatch
retain the failed outcome; never substitute a success

sampling.minimumUninterruptedSequence: one six-ball sequence per title/configuration when the game mode permits
sampling.sameDeviceRule: controlled Android competitors use the same owned phone, display mode, orientation, refresh, thermal window, network class and recording settings
sampling.vandeOwnedTelemetry: may supplement video only for VANDE and must be provenance-linked

metrics.definition: first launch/start marker to first playable release
deliberate actions before first playable release
annotated ball bounding-box mean diameter at release
annotated ball bounding-box mean diameter at bounce
annotated ball bounding-box mean diameter near contact
annotated visible-ball samples divided by required tracking samples
axis-aligned annotated occlusion area intersecting the declared decision corridor divided by corridor area
annotated cuts from approach through dead ball
impact-audio onset minus physical contact; only synchronized audio/event evidence
authoritative/annotated physical result to visible score response
authoritative/annotated physical result to crowd response
result-visible marker to next playable state
non-interactive dead time divided by setup-to-next-playable duration
union/declared HUD area divided by viewport area
visible persistent interactive controls during the decision corridor
consecutive byte-identical decoded video frames divided by adjacent frame pairs; recording property only
independently reviewed visible contradictions between live result, replay, score, audio or Coach

uncertainty.frameTime: half one frame interval at the declared capture frame rate unless a more precise synchronized clock is proven
uncertainty.manualRegion: report annotator confidence and preserve independent annotations/adjudication
uncertainty.missing: NOT_AVAILABLE or NOT_COMPARABLE; never impute zero
uncertainty.diagnostic: label DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; exclude from human control, preference, fun and commercial-success claims

exclusions: cross-game SSIM, PSNR, LPIPS or VMAF as a quality ranking
engine FPS, input latency, physics correctness or control feel inferred from public/compressed video
AI persona, owner opinion or machine input counted as a player

scoring.ceri: map evidence availability only; CERI dimension scores require the evidence specified by docs/evaluation/CRICKET-EXPERIENCE-SUCCESS-METRIC.md
scoring.directionality: display raw values and uncertainty; do not aggregate unlike scenario classes

deviationPolicy: A later change creates a new registration version and states the reason; never edit this file after viewing comparison results.
